name: Disney+

fastest.text: Open disneyplus.com/account/cancel-subscription in a browser, sign in and confirm. You can't cancel in the Disney+ mobile app.

steps: Sign in at disneyplus.com in a web browser (the mobile app can't cancel).
Select your profile icon, then Account.
Under Subscription, select your Disney+ plan, then Cancel Subscription.
Pick a reason if asked, confirm, and look for the confirmation email.
note: Got Disney+ through a bundle, your phone carrier, Roku or Amazon? Cancel with whoever bills you.

faq.q: Do I keep watching after I cancel?
faq.a: Yes. The cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period, and you can keep watching until then.
Normally no. Disney+ doesn't refund or credit the unused part of a billing period.
No. Your Disney account stays; deleting it is a separate option in your account settings.
